name: so-me-studio
description: Upload images and videos, then draft, publish, and schedule social posts with So-me Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Draft, publish, and schedule social posts.
interface.longDescription: Upload images and videos or choose existing library media, then draft, publish, and schedule posts for your connected social accounts. Review your calendar, edit upcoming posts, and check publication status. Includes upload verification and media drafts. Requires API/MCP access and connected accounts; supported formats and post types depend on the destination platform. Local uploads require access to the source file and an HTTP upload capability.
